Hi Kwame — thanks for the quick packet and the VAT number. Glad to get Akoma live.

High-level answers first, with required next steps below so finance can issue the PO without delay:

1) VAT: Our default is to accept VAT-inclusive invoices when the supplier is VAT-registered locally. We have a separate flow for reverse-charge; that typically requires verification from our tax team and documented business reason.
2) Withholding: Redwood may be required to deduct local withholding on certain service categories. We need to confirm rate and whether treaty relief applies — please provide a Tax Residency Certificate if you have one.

To move forward please send:
- Copy of Tax Residency Certificate (if available) — scanned PDF.
- Confirmation whether the first invoices will be for GOODS only or for SERVICES (or both).
- Bank details confirmation (you already attached — finance will review).

I've attached our standard PO terms for your review (Redwood_PO_Template_v1.pdf). Once finance confirms bank details and tax classification, we will issue PO PO-AC-7842 and send for signature.

Looping in Laura (tax) and Rishi (payments) to confirm withholding/VAT handling and the timeline for PO activation.

Best,

Subject: Re: Intro & onboarding documents — Akoma Supplies (tax view)

Hi team and Kwame — I reviewed the attachments. Notes and action items: 

- VAT: Ghana VAT is 12.5% on taxable supplies. For goods supplied in-country (delivery/acceptance in Ghana), the vendor should charge Ghana VAT. Because Akoma is registered (documented), they should invoice Redwood with VAT on the invoice if the supply is Ghana taxable.

- Reverse charge: Not applicable for in-country goods. Reverse-charge usually applies to cross-border services and is fact-specific; not relevant to this shipment of hardware stored/delivered in Ghana.

- Withholding: For GOODS (sale of goods), we typically do NOT withhold. Withholding is more common on services and certain technical fees. Given Kwame confirmed this first order is for goods only, Redwood should pay gross (no withholding).

- Tax residency certificate: Good to have on file; if we ever need treaty relief for services, we'll request notarized version and a local tax opinion.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to validate bank details and create vendor record in the AP system.
2) Stephanie to confirm PO currency and sign-off.
3) Akoma to send VAT-inclusive invoice (show VAT amount and VAT reg number).

Rishi — can you confirm AP ETA for vendor activation and whether Redwood will raise the PO in USD?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Lead Tax Counsel | Redwood Inference
